requirements.requirement: The system must execute unit tests validating that raw measure values are correctly transformed into normalized scores according to defined formulas.
The system must verify via unit tests that each measure's contribution to the final score is correctly computed as normalized_score multiplied by weight.
The system must validate that the sum of all measure contributions equals the final composite score within an acceptable tolerance.
The system must ensure unit tests confirm deterministic outputs for identical input values across multiple test runs.
The system must validate that normalization logic handles boundary values (e.g., min and max inputs) correctly.
The system must validate that negative or out-of-range raw values are handled according to defined normalization rules.

The system must execute integration tests confirming that the evaluate_care_facade returns an explainability payload containing measure_id, raw_value, normalized_score, weight, and contribution_to_final_score.
The system must validate via integration tests that the explainability payload is included in the API response returned by the FastAPI endpoint.
The system must ensure that the explainability payload structure conforms exactly to the defined response schema.
The system must validate that multiple measures are returned in the explainability payload when multiple inputs are provided.
The system must ensure integration tests validate correct ordering or consistent handling of measures in the response payload.
The system must validate that missing optional fields in input data do not break explainability payload generation.
The system must verify that when normalization logic receives null or invalid inputs, a controlled error or fallback behavior is triggered.
The system must validate that API responses return an appropriate error status when explainability computation fails.
The system must ensure test coverage includes both successful explainability generation and at least two failure scenarios.
